messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan ignoring missing cases
parts:
Your summary() function should reference the output from the cfa function, fit_cba, not your model syntax object, CBA_model.
The warning message says that 60 cases are entirely missing. Look at the data in R to see if this is true. If you are using R Studio, just double-click on the data.frame object, Youth_Affinity, in the Environment pane on the upper right.

messages.author: 99a06696c483481a
messages.subject: Re: Lavaan ignoring missing cases
parts: If all information is missing for a given case, there is no statistical basis for assigning a likelihood. FIML needs some "knowns" in each case. If you want those cases included in your analysis, you may be able to accomplish this using auxiliary variables where you do have data for those cases. But you will have to include those variables in your analysis somehow.
